newsitem.title: USA: U.S. to speed up consideration of Conrail takeover.
newsitem.headline: U.S. to speed up consideration of Conrail takeover.

text.p: The Surface Transportation Board said on Wednesday it had agreed to a speed up its consideration of the acquisition of Conrail Inc. by CSX Corp and Norfolk Southern Corp.

It also said the acquiring carriers told it they intended to file a joint application to acquire Conrail by July 10, rather than the separate applications planned when they had been competing to buy Conrail. Under the new proposed hearing schedule, the board said a final decision on the acquisition, following the filing of extensive briefs, responses and public hearings, would be made in 255 days.
It previously had said a decision would be issued in about 300 days. CSX and Norfolk Southern had asked for the speed-up.
If the schedule held, the two carriers could take over Conrail in March 1998, but it could come sooner if the two carriers made their filing before the July 10 date.
